# Keep Rust automation task labels matched to the current build graph

The Rust vendoring bot now writes normal linux64, macosx64 and win64 opt build labels to try_task_config.json. Dedicated Rust labels stopped matching after Rust became enabled in the standard builds. run_try_cc writes and adds this file before its production push. Check producer labels against the build graph when a default changes; an otherwise valid JSON file can still request nonexistent tasks. The script’s snake_case names and the graph’s dash/slash task labels have different roles. No graph generation or Try push was run.

Scope: Rust automation and task naming.
